items.name: claralight
items.title: ClaraLight Design
items.description: The base: design tokens, component primitives and the configured class merger. Install this first, or let any component pull it in as a dependency.
items.author: ClaraLight

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The ClaraLight capsule control: four variants, three densities, and the signature press spring.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field whose fill is a translucent overlay, so it reads correctly on the window background and inside a panel alike.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface on the ClaraLight layer stack, in the three places a card can sit: on the window, inside a panel, or floating over content.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A frosted modal. Base UI owns focus trapping, scroll locking, Escape and nested dialogs; ClaraLight owns the surface and the entrance.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A select whose popup grows from the trigger, because Base UI computes --transform-origin from the trigger's real position.
